name: Yamaha XS400
engine: 391 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, two carbs
intro: A cheap, common Yamaha twin. The usual weak spots are the charging parts and starter clutch.

add.title: Check the starter clutch
add.instructions: If the starter spins but the engine only turns now and then, the starter clutch is slipping. Check its springs and rollers.
add.reason: Worn or broken starter clutch springs are a known XS400 fault.

F: The voltage regulator/rectifier is a common failure on these. Test it before blaming the stator.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
